subsystems.name: Resource extraction
subsystems.role: mines and hauls local rock and soil to feed the plant.

subsystems.name: Materials refining
subsystems.role: turns raw soil into usable metal, oxygen and volatiles.

subsystems.name: Fabrication cells
subsystems.role: make finished parts rather than merely purifying material.
parts: metal additive manufacturing (laser or electron-beam powder bed, wire deposition)

subsystems.name: Assembly and handling
subsystems.role: puts parts into machines, including the machines themselves.
parts: robotic arms on mobile or gantry bases

subsystems.name: Metrology and verification
subsystems.role: measures each product against the master specification so error is caught, not inherited.

subsystems.name: Imported 'vitamin' set
subsystems.role: the small, high-value fraction the plant cannot yet make.

subsystems.name: Power, control and thermal
subsystems.role: runs the plant and keeps every cell in range.
parts: solar arrays or fission power unit
distributed control software and master-spec model

buildSteps.title: Characterise the site
buildSteps.detail: Land a survey payload first: assay the regolith for iron, titanium, aluminium, silicon, oxygen and volatiles, and map ice or ore bodies. Manufacturing design follows the ore body, not the other way round.

buildSteps.title: Land a minimal seed
buildSteps.detail: Deliver the smallest self-contained kit that can do useful work: power, a digger, a smelter or electrolysis cell, one or two fabrication cells, robots, and imported electronics.

buildSteps.title: Commission power and mining
buildSteps.detail: Bring the power source online, then prove the digger can deliver consistent feedstock. Inconsistent feedstock is the usual first failure.

buildSteps.title: Produce feedstock materials
buildSteps.detail: Refine regolith into metal, oxygen and volatiles. Early output is crude — ingots, powder, sintered blocks — and is graded by the metrology cell before it is allowed into parts.

buildSteps.title: Make simple parts
buildSteps.detail: Start with parts that carry no precision requirement: structural beams, trusses, housings, fasteners, cable trays. Each one is measured against the master specification and the process is tuned until it passes.

buildSteps.title: Climb the part ladder
buildSteps.detail: Gradually raise complexity — gear blanks, machined brackets, pressure vessels, motor housings, then moving assemblies. The plant only attempts a part class once the previous class reliably passes inspection.

buildSteps.title: Build one subsystem of itself
buildSteps.detail: The first true closure step: use the plant's own output to make a complete working subsystem — typically a second digger, a conveyor, or a machine-tool frame — and prove it by putting it into service.

buildSteps.title: Verify the copy and iterate
buildSteps.detail: Compare each generation against the master model, quarantining any unit that fails, then add the next production module. Each generation closes a little more of the mass loop and leaves a smaller import list.

buildSteps.title: Ramp toward exponential output
buildSteps.detail: Once copies reliably make copies, capacity compounds: the plant builds machines that build machines. Throughput climbs toward the target tonnage rate while imported electronics and catalysts remain the throttle.

prerequisites.tech: In-situ resource utilisation at pilot scale
prerequisites.why: producing oxygen and water from local material has been demonstrated on Mars and proposed for the Moon, but never at industrial throughput.
molten-oxide and molten-salt electrolysis can in principle yield iron, aluminium, titanium and oxygen from soil, but only at laboratory scale.
robots can weld, machine and bolt parts on Earth, but unsupervised multi-step assembly over years without repair crews is unproven.

prerequisites.tech: Additive manufacturing in vacuum and low gravity
prerequisites.why: metal and regolith printing has been tested in relevant conditions, but not at structural quality or volume.
the whole concept depends on software that catches its own manufacturing drift; nothing at this breadth exists.
without tight accounting of mass in, mass out and defect rates, a seed factory quietly stalls rather than growing.

pathway.milestone: ISRU demonstrations and robotic construction experiments
pathway.unlocks: real numbers for oxygen yield, printing quality and digger reliability.

pathway.milestone: a pilot plant making propellant, water and simple structural parts from local material
pathway.unlocks: a landed base that resupplies itself for some consumables.

pathway.milestone: partial closure — the plant builds one working subsystem of itself, verified against a specification
pathway.unlocks: the first measured reproduction rate, and a realistic import list.

pathway.milestone: multi-generation growth, with capacity compounding instead of being resupplied
pathway.unlocks: off-world industry that scales in tonnage per day rather than depending on Earth launches.
